products.body:
The Ice Nino Down sleeping bag is the ideal overnight companion for smaller-framed adventurers. Known as the younger brother of the Ice Breaker sleeping bag, the Ice Nino is versatile, durable and designed to last a lifetime. Comfort rated at 1°C, and Comfort Limit at -5°C, this bag will keep you insulated and safe.

This sleeping bag comes with a right-side zip. A left-side zip is available on request.
products.title: First Ascent Ice Nino Down Sleeping Bag

featured_image.alt: First Ascent Ice Nino down sleeping bag in grey and yellow, fully extended with hood open to show red lining

products.body:
The Ice Breaker Down sleeping bag is the perfect all-rounder for colder overnight conditions. Comfort rated at -3°C, and transition rated at -8°C, this bag is ideal for summiting Kilimanjaro, or backpacking through the Drakensberg in winter. Its scalloped neck and face baffle will prevent cold air from creeping in, irrespective of the forecast.

This sleeping bag comes with a right-side zip. A left-side zip is available on request.
products.title: First Ascent Ice Breaker Down Sleeping Bag

featured_image.alt: First Ascent Ice Breaker Down sleeping bag in Regular, upright with dark grey base, olive green top and red hood lining

products.body:
The Amplify Down 900 sleeping bag is the ideal versatile bag for more extreme weather conditions. Designed for expeditions to Mt. Kenya, Kilimanjaro and Everest Base Camp. Comfort rated at -8°C, and transition rated to -15°C, this bag will keep you insulated and comfortable when needed most.

This sleeping bag comes with a right-side zip. A left-side zip is available on request.
products.title: First Ascent Amplify Down 900 Sleeping Bag

featured_image.alt: First Ascent Amplify Down 900 sleeping bag in charcoal and blue, mummy-style, shown upright with hood at top

products.body: The Ultralight Insulated Plus Pad is designed to be packable and lightweight without compromising insulation. Two layers of thermal foil insulate this mattress making it ideal for cooler winter conditions. At 490g, there's no compromise between weight and space.
products.title: First Ascent Ultralight Plus Insulated Sleeping Pad

featured_image.alt: First Ascent Ultralight Plus insulated sleeping pad in turquoise, fully inflated and seen from above

products.body: The First Ascent Comfort Light Mattress is the ideal overnight companion for your next camping getaway. This trekking mat offers 3.8cm of superior padding that will ensure ultimate comfort when tucking in under the stars. The full length contour design expertly moulds to the shape of your body, for a more comfortable feel, while the extra thick foam increases insulation so you never go to sleep cold again. Integrated pillow attachments offer improved comfort and versatility, while the lightweight design won't take up unnecessary space or weight on your travels.
products.title: First Ascent Comfort Light Sleeping Pad

featured_image.alt: First Ascent Comfort Light sleeping pad in taupe grey, unrolled and shown upright with small branding near one end

products.body:
When space and weight are concerns, the Amplify 900 Synthetic Sleeping Bag is the answer. Ideal for summer or spring backpacking and hiking with new Amplify (expand) technology in knee and hip area to minimise heat loss. With a comfort rating of 7°C and transition rating of 2°C, this is a great three season sleeping bag. It also features a reflective zip puller and internal pocket for valuables.

This sleeping bag comes with a right-side zip. A left-side zip is available on request.
products.title: First Ascent Amplify 900 Synthetic Sleeping Bag

featured_image.alt: First Ascent Amplify 900 Synthetic Sleeping Bag in teal and pale blue, fully laid out upright with its hood open

products.body: The Contour sleeping pad is a light, compact, closed-cell mattress featuring an accordion-style shape with heat-trapping dimples. Wherever you're headed, the Contour sleeping pad is the right choice for ultralight warmth, durability and comfort.
products.title: First Ascent Contour Sleeping Pad

featured_image.alt: First Ascent Contour sleeping pad in turquoise-blue, laid flat upright with its segmented textured surface

products.body:
The Explorer Down sleeping bag is the ideal summer bag for the traveller who requires a lightweight, yet durable bag. Comfort rated at 5°C and transition at 0°C, this sleeping bag will ensure a peaceful night's sleep during the summer months, as well as moderate cooler nights. Still too cold? Add a thermal sleeping bag liner to increase the insulation capabilities of this sleeping bag.

This sleeping bag comes with a right-side zip. A left-side zip is available on request.
products.title: First Ascent Explorer Down Sleeping Bag

featured_image.alt: First Ascent Explorer down sleeping bag in orange and charcoal grey, standing upright with its hood open

products.body: Protect yourself and your family from annoying mosquitoes with this Spreader Mosquito Net - King sized. It uses a durable, lightweight and fine mesh that is designed to prevent mosquitos from passing through. Using shock-corded fiberglass poles, the net hangs from a central point when assembled, and creates a very large internal area giving an unparalleled feeling of space. Perfect for use at home and camping.
products.title: First Ascent Spreader Mosquito Net

featured_image.alt: First Ascent spreader mosquito net in white, hung open with its mesh panels hanging down and pooling slightly

products.body:
The Amplify 1500 Synthetic sleeping bag sports Thermo-Shield insulation with a soft touch Microtex lining for unmatched comfort on overnight adventures. The Amplify (expand) technology in the knee and hip area, combined with the Illuminate warmth reflector ensures that minimal heat loss takes place, making this the ideal sleeping bag for three-season comfort. Comfort rated at 5°C, and transition rated at -2°C, this bag won't let you down during moderate winter nights.

This sleeping bag comes with a right-side zip. A left-side zip is available on request.
